name: wordpress-content
description: A lightweight local-first WordPress content workflow: theme, blocks, patterns, layouts and copy, browser verification, live apply, and rollback on failure, with no Git workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Manage WordPress content locally first, then apply it live.
interface.longDescription: A lightweight WordPress content-management workflow that starts with the installed theme, then registered blocks, patterns, page layouts, copy and media. It uses temporary files rather than Git operations, verifies locally in a real browser, captures a live rollback snapshot, applies the verified payload, and rolls back immediately if live verification fails.
defaultPrompt: Build this WordPress page locally from the active theme, blocks, patterns, layout and copy, then verify it in a browser.
Apply the locally verified WordPress content live with a rollback ready, and roll back if verification fails.
Manage this WordPress content without Git or Standard Development Workflow.
